versions.changelog:
- Introduced initial release of the original v1 taste-skill under the new install name `design-taste-frontend-v1` for strict backward compatibility.
- Baseline configuration strictly specifies DESIGN_VARIANCE, MOTION_INTENSITY, and VISUAL_DENSITY values and their dynamic usage.
- Enforces architectural conventions: dependency checks, React/Next.js (with preference for server components), Tailwind CSS versioning, and icon usage.
- Introduces strict design engineering directives to reduce LLM UI bias, enforce high-end mockup standards, and prohibit clichés (e.g., no emojis, no "AI Purple").
- Integrates advanced interaction and animation patterns for creative, premium UI experiences—including microphysics, glass effect, and motion orchestration.
- Sets detailed standards for responsiveness, accessibility, state handling, and performance optimization in frontend code.
